text:
Jordan P: Hi all, quick onboarding/payroll q. I enrolled in medical + dental but my plan premium looks higher than I expected. Did I accidentally pick family instead of employee-only? Also where do I confirm my PTO balance for the first pay period?

Ana (People Ops): Welcome Jordan! :wave: Check Workday > Benefits > Elections to confirm dependent tier. If it shows 'Family' we can change it during the 30-day new hire window. PTO balance visible at Workday > Time Off > Balances. New hires accrue from start date; first accrual posts on the next payroll.

Jordan P: I see 'Family' in Elections but didn't add dependents. Could that happen automatically?

Benefits Admin: That can happen if a default election was selected during signup or if a carrier mapping defaulted. DM us your employee ID and we can correct it. If changed within 30 days we can make it retroactive to your coverage effective date.

Jordan P: Great — filing a DM now. One more: I submitted a $120 monitor arm reimbursement via Expensify and it still says "Pending Finance". Any idea timeline?

Payroll Bot: Reimbursement flow: People Ops reviews within 3 business days, Finance pays on the next AP run (Tue/Thu). If tagged "newhire-setup" and <=$500 it usually clears on the next AP after approval.

Lena M: If manager approval is blocking, ping your manager in-thread or ask them to approve in the Expensify mobile app (super fast). We can also temporarily expedite one-off new-hire essentials if needed.

Jordan P: Thanks! Last tiny thing: are company holidays front-loaded for the year or tied to start date? I start 2025-12-15 and worried about year-end holidays.

Ana (People Ops): Holidays are fixed dates and you get paid for a holiday only if employed on that date. The floating holiday is prorated based on start month. PTO accruals still apply per policy for partial months.

Jordan P: Perfect, that's clear. Appreciate the quick answers :thumbsup:
